name: PRDBench
intro: PRDBench 是面向真实产品需求文档（PRD）的项目级代码生成基准，包含 50 个 Python 项目、20 个领域和 1,262 个可执行评分点，并以单元测试、Shell 交互和文件比较检验工程交付。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Meituan, AGI-Eval
build_method: Agent驱动PRD与测试标准生成, 人工执行检查, 迭代修复
task_type: 项目级代码生成, 软件工程, 调试
eval_feature: PRD驱动, 单元测试/Shell交互/文件比较, Agent-as-a-Judge, 开发与调试双轮
scale: 50个项目级任务, 20个领域, 1,262个评分点
task_type_en: Project-level code generation, software engineering, debugging
build_method_en: Agent-generated PRDs and test criteria, human execution checks, iterative repair
eval_feature_en: PRD-driven, unit tests/shell interaction/file comparison, Agent-as-a-Judge, development and debugging rounds
intro_en: PRDBench is a project-level code-generation benchmark built from real product requirement documents. It contains 50 Python projects across 20 domains and 1,262 executable evaluation points spanning unit tests, shell interaction, and file comparison.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2510.24358 and the official PRDBench repository: seed requirements are filtered to public all-Python projects, GPT-4 assigns domains, and 50 projects across 20 domains are selected. Agents draft the PRD, AAA-oriented metric outline, scaffold, and criteria; humans execute and inspect tests; failures are iteratively repaired; the scaffold is then removed. EvalAgent runs 409 unit-test, 729 shell-interaction, and 124 file-comparison points and reports pass rate.
